title: albizia quartiniana
intro: Albizia quartiniana, commonly known as the Suddour tree, is a species of legume native to the tropical regions of Africa and the Middle East. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, digestive problems, and skin conditions, due to its reported health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Albizia quartiniana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. Research has identified the presence of isoflavonoids, such as quercetin and kaempferol, among the bioactive constituents of this plant, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
